_comment: OPT-IN. Merge the `hooks` block into your .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json) in one reviewed commit (H6). INTERACTIVE sessions only: a driver child never creates
worktrees (the driver's scheduler does, `parallel_mode: worktree`), so do not add this to a child's profile. A WorktreeCreate hook REPLACES the platform's own worktree creation:
it cuts the worktree off the LOCAL integration branch (not the remote default), under .claude/worktrees/<name> only, reserves a port slot and prints the path.
The event names WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove and the fields of their input (`name`, `worktree_path`, `cwd`) are unverified on the pinned CLI (probe V6 / V25);
worktree_hook.py refuses any shape it does not recognise (exit 2), which for WorktreeCreate means the platform's creation fails rather than doing something else.
Replace __KIT__ with the kit folder (the `kit:` line of the session context or of the doctor): ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is not set in settings-file hooks.
Also copy ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/worktreeinclude to ./.worktreeinclude if you want .env.local / .env.test in the new worktree (nothing else is ever copied).
